manifest.title: The ball stops rising. Gravity doesn’t stop.
manifest.summary: A ball is tossed straight up on a fixed height scale. A Motion arrow shrinks, vanishes at the top and reverses, while the gravity arrow stays the same.
assumptions: Gravity fixed at 9.8 m/s^2, no air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.description: One ball rises and falls beside a fixed height scale with a launch guide. The blue Motion arrow follows the velocity. The dashed gravity arrow always points down with the same length.

program.source: export function evaluate({inputs,time}){const g=9.8,u=inputs.launchSpeed;const T=u/g;const t=Math.min(Math.max(time,0),2*T);const h=u*t-g*t*t/2;const v=u-g*t;const H=u*u/(2*g);const base=360,pxm=200;const y=base-h*pxm;const x=250;const top=Math.abs(t-T)<0.004;const st=top?'Still for an instant':(v>0?'Moving up':'Moving down');const o=[];o.push(...sdk.panel({x:20,y:40,w:600,h:360,title:'Toss',state:st,id:'lane.toss'}));o.push(sdk.axis('axis.h',{x:90,y:base,length:300,orientation:'y',min:0,max:1.5,ticks:[0,0.5,1,1.5],label:'Height',unit:'m'}));o.push(sdk.line('guide.launch',100,base,200,base,{role:'neutral'}));o.push(sdk.circle('ball.toss',x,y-12,24,{}));const vv=top?0:v;o.push(...sdk.vector('vec.v',{x:x+40,y:y},{value:vv,direction:'up'},{scale:30,label:'v'}));o.push(...sdk.vector('vec.a',{x:x+120,y:y},{value:-g,direction:'up'},{scale:10,label:'a',role:'warning'}));o.push(...sdk.callout(400,150,['Gravity pulls down',st],{id:'callout.toss'}));return{frame:{width:640,height:420,objects:o,readouts:[{id:'motionState',value:st},{id:'gravityState',value:'Gravity pulls down'}]},quantities:{launchSpeed:u,gravity:g,apexTime:T,apexHeight:H,velocity:v,height:h}};}
